about: Bare hands' jump (milestone-1 task 59): one flight from take-off to touchdown on the disarmed arc, 34 rules frames in the air (17 source frames), the legs and body from Jump01's airborne frames (its feet leave on 6 and land on 29), the upper body (spine, chest, head and arms) held in bare hands' guard, fists closed, from their idle (CombatIdle01) throughout, and the legs reaching down into that idle's stance for the touchdown, so the landing starts where the feet come down; key poses at the take-off, rising, the top, falling and the touchdown, Cascadeur inbetweening the rest. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
